parameters.description: The prompt: pick one, or type its name (with its folder, such as support/answer).
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The version's number, such as the version of Create prompt version.
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: The labels to give it, such as production.
parameters.name: labels

added_labels.description: The labels moved to this version

commit_message.description: The note saved with this version

compiled.description: The prompt with the variables you gave filled in, ready to send to a model (a chat prompt as role: content lines)

compiled_messages.description: A chat prompt's messages with the variables filled in

config.description: Its config, such as the model and temperature

id.description: The prompt version's ID, for Add comment

labels.description: This version's labels, such as production and latest

link.description: A link to the prompt version in Langfuse

messages.description: A chat prompt's messages as written; empty for a text prompt

missing_variables.description: The variables it has that you didn't give

prompt.description: The prompt as written, with its {{variables}}; a chat prompt as role: content lines

description: Automate around your LLM app in Langfuse: list and read traces with their cost, log traces and generations, score them, get prompts with their variables filled in, save and promote prompt versions, keep test datasets and read daily cost and tokens. Start a workflow on a new trace, a low score or negative feedback, a new prompt version or a label moved.

langfuse_new_prompt_version_trigger.description: Runs when a prompt gets a new version, or a new prompt is made, with its text, labels and config: of every prompt or the one you choose.

parameters.description: Only this prompt, by name. Leave blank for every prompt.
parameters.name: prompt

langfuse_new_score_trigger.description: Runs when a trace, observation or session is scored, such as a low evaluation score or a user's thumbs down: by score name, and at most or at least a value, or equal to one.

parameters.description: Only scores with this name, such as helpfulness or user-feedback. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Only scores of this number or less, such as 0.5. True counts as 1 and false as 0, so 0 catches a thumbs down.
parameters.name: at_most

parameters.description: Only scores of this number or more.
parameters.name: at_least

parameters.description: Only scores of exactly this value, such as false or a category such as negative.
parameters.name: value

langfuse_new_trace_trigger.description: Runs when a new trace arrives in Langfuse, of every name or the one you choose, with a tag or for a user, with its input and output. Traces from before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only traces with this name, such as support-chat. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Only traces with this tag. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Only traces for this user, as your app names them. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: user

langfuse_prompt_label_moved_trigger.description: Runs when a label such as production moves to another version of a prompt, such as when a new version is promoted or rolled back, with the version that has it now.

parameters.description: Only this prompt, by name. Leave blank for every prompt.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: The label to watch, such as production or staging. Defaults to production.
parameters.name: label
